notes.title: Translation update and new game teaser
notes.content:
We have localized achievements into Turkish and updated the Turkish and Russian translations of the game. Please contact us if you would like to help us translate the game into your language! Email: anityper@gmail.com

notes.title: YOU’VE GOT A MATCH!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928354/e5139ed7ee5c1289f6344efa7400ffceeb618859.png[/img]

[h1]Two new dates![/h1]
One will happen in a dark alleyway, the other—in an MMORPG! Both girls were suggested to us by the players who bought the game in Early Access. Take up a dangerous criminal or a dark elf on their lewd offers and enjoy animated 18+ scenes or get yourself together and return home to your favorite videogames and anime!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928354/bcbd0e6764a563cb07b47676f8743a7b0aafa770.png[/img]

[h1]STEAM CARDS! COOL GAMER BADGES AND EMOJIS![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928354/84a251975186f0fc6e2a3ee8ce4aaea513c93c8e.png[/img]

[h1]Improved clicker Mechanics.[/h1]
Your old saves may not work. Use the [b]secret code DEADP47[/b] to get extra points quick and gain access to new dates.

[h1]Added French translation.[/h1]
Want to help us translate the game into your native language? Please tell us about that in the comments! Thank you all for your support!
